description:
## Fixes

- **YouTube Music crossfade (#45):** When a song was started by tapping it, crossfade read a stale pause event,
  muted the still-playing previous song and then restored it at full level when the next track loaded,
  causing an abrupt jump. Crossfade now reads the live player state. A genuinely paused previous song stays
  silent and is released without fading back in or being revived on cancel.

## Known limitation

Verified on Motorola. The Poco/HyperOS burst is **not yet confirmed fixed**. Please retest with the same
**10 s, Equal power** setup at low speaker volume. If it persists, enable debug logging, reproduce it, then
use **Export debug logs** and include the exact burst timestamps.

This is a development prerelease, not a stable promotion.

Modified by lavinhoque33, 2026-11-12.
